projects.name: ETERNITY---Virtual-Assistant
projects.description: A Virtual Assistant to automate many tasks
projects.headline: Voice-controlled virtual assistant for task automation
projects.what: The assistant listens for spoken commands, maps them to predefined actions, and executes tasks such as retrieving the time, searching the web, playing music, or sending email. It is written in Python, uses speech-recognition libraries for audio input, and calls external services via HTTP or system calls. An optional OpenAI key enables ChatGPT-style conversational responses through the E.T.E.R.GPT module.
projects.why: It provides a hands-free way to perform frequent computer tasks, reducing manual interaction for the user.
projects.impact: Shows the ability to combine speech processing, API integration, and OS automation in a single Python application.
highlights: Integrates Google, YouTube, and Spotify queries
Adds ChatGPT-style interaction via OpenAI API
Automates OS actions like screenshots and email launch

projects.name: Kaalka-Encryption-Algorithm
projects.description: Kaalka Encryption is designed to work seamlessly across multiple platforms and provides a versatile encryption mechanism that incorporates the progressive value of time. By using dynamic time-based encryption, you can achieve secure communication that is inherently bound to a specific moment in time.
projects.headline: Time-based cross-platform encryption library with CLI and file support
projects.what: Provides a time-driven encryption protocol that creates unique ciphertexts tied to a specific timestamp. Implements envelope, seal, replay protection, and chunked file encryption, exposed through a JavaScript web demo and a multi-language CLI. The core logic is written in JavaScript and duplicated in Python, Java, Kotlin, and Dart with unit tests ensuring identical behavior.
projects.why: Enables secure communication that expires or becomes invalid outside its intended time window, mitigating replay attacks and simplifying cross-platform key management.
projects.impact: Shows end-to-end design and implementation of a cryptographic protocol across front-end and multiple back-end runtimes.
highlights: Chunked file encryption with lossless round-trip

projects.name: SHE
projects.description: A Programming Language
projects.headline: SHE - a beginner-friendly interpreted programming language
projects.what: SHE is an interpreted language written in Python that provides a simple syntax for arithmetic, variables, conditionals, loops, functions, strings, and lists. The interpreter includes a REPL and a script runner that execute .she files. Built-in functions expose the Kaalka encryption package for message encryption and decryption.
projects.why: It offers a lightweight teaching tool for newcomers to programming while demonstrating how to embed cryptographic primitives in a language runtime.
projects.impact: Shows end-to-end design and implementation of a custom interpreter with integrated security features.
highlights: Implements lexer, parser, and runtime in Python
Supports variables, loops, functions, and lists

projects.name: WebWeaveX
projects.description: Deterministic runtime cognition infrastructure for humans and AI agents — the same input yields the same SHA-256 across Python, JavaScript, Dart, Java and Kotlin.
projects.headline: Deterministic cross-language runtime cognition platform for humans and AI agents
projects.what: Provides a canonical, graph-structured runtime model of web apps, desktop software, and backend services that yields identical SHA-256 hashes for the same input across Python, TypeScript, Dart, Java, and Kotlin SDKs. The system captures DOM events, state machines, and network traffic, then stores them in a deterministic intermediate representation that can be replayed or reconstructed. SDKs expose the model and cryptographic identity via Kaalka v5 encryption.
projects.why: Existing scrapers and automation tools cannot reliably handle dynamic, authenticated, and stateful software, making auditing and AI-driven interaction brittle. The platform enables reliable replay and reasoning for both human engineers and autonomous agents.
projects.impact: Shows ability to design and deliver a multi-SDK deterministic runtime system spanning five programming languages.
highlights: Deterministic SHA-256 graph hashes across languages
SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Dart, Java, Kotlin
Cross-language parity with Kaalka v5 encryption

projects.name: RAG-Application
projects.description: A comprehensive, production-ready RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) application that enables users to upload documents, ask questions, and receive AI-powered answers with proper citations. Built with modern technologies and best practices for scalability and reliability.
projects.headline: Production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation web app
projects.what: A web application that lets users upload .txt, .pdf, .docx, and .md files, then ask natural-language questions and receive AI-generated answers with inline citations. The pipeline chunks documents, creates embeddings with Google Gemini, stores vectors in Pinecone, applies MMR retrieval and Cohere reranking before generating responses via Groq’s Llama-3.3 model. The front end shows real-time timing, token usage, and cost metrics.
projects.why: Provides a low-cost, end-to-end solution for extracting information from heterogeneous user documents while preserving source provenance.
projects.impact: Demonstrates ability to integrate multiple AI services, vector databases, and a responsive UI into a cohesive RAG system.
highlights: Real-time metrics: timing, token usage, cost
Hybrid retrieval with MMR and Cohere reranking
Inline citations linked to source snippets

projects.name: Dockeroid
projects.description: Web based solution for Android application emulation and testing. Dockeroid where web and android meets together.
projects.headline: Docker image for web-based Android app emulation and testing
projects.what: Builds a Docker image based on Ubuntu that installs Python 3, OpenJDK 11, Android SDK, ADB, QEMU-KVM and related libvirt tools. The image creates an Android Virtual Device (API 30) and configures KVM permissions, then runs a Bash shell that can be used by a web front-end to upload APKs and display the app inside the emulator. The setup is scripted entirely in a Dockerfile and supporting shell scripts.
projects.why: Enables testing of Android applications without enabling unknown-source installs on physical devices, allowing developers to run and view apps directly from a browser.
projects.impact: Shows expertise in containerizing a full Android development stack and automating emulator provisioning.
highlights: Automates Android SDK install in Docker
Creates AVD with API 30 via script
Configures KVM access for hardware acceleration
Provides web UI for APK upload and display

projects.name: Texter
projects.description: A Common Platform for Text analysis in your documents.
projects.headline: Common platform for document text analysis
projects.what: Provides a suite of activities—text cleaning, emotion classification, summarization, and entity checking—through a unified Python codebase. The pipeline is organized in Jupyter notebooks and packaged as a Docker container for reproducible execution. Users can run the service locally or via the provided Docker image.
projects.why: Creates a single entry point for preprocessing and extracting insights from arbitrary documents, reducing the need to stitch together separate tools.
projects.impact: Demonstrates ability to design and containerize an end-to-end NLP workflow from raw text to analytical results.
highlights: Text cleaning with case, stopwords, URLs, emails

projects.name: NATRAJ
projects.description: NATRAJ - A localized End to End encrypted server with Neural Networks to act as a packet filtering firewall and accessing the internet using proxy for actual device ID masking.
projects.headline: Localized end-to-end encrypted server with NN-based packet filtering firewall
projects.what: A local server receives all device requests, encrypts traffic end-to-end, and forwards it through a proxy that masks the external IP. It assigns a unique hash to each device and router, using the hash table for packet routing. Traffic is passed to a one-dimensional convolutional neural network that classifies packets as benign or malicious before reaching the internet.
projects.why: Increasing packet-level cyber attacks require a gateway that secures internal traffic and hides device identities when accessing external networks.
projects.impact: Demonstrates building a secure network gateway that combines encryption, hashing, and neural-network traffic classification in production code.

projects.name: YouTube-Shorts-Automation
projects.description: A youtube shorts automation. From idea generation to upload end to end.
projects.headline: End-to-end YouTube Shorts creation and upload pipeline
projects.what: The service generates a short concept with Gemini, writes a script, creates a TTS voiceover via edge-tts, produces captions, builds a thumbnail, assembles the video using MoviePy, and uploads it to YouTube. All steps are orchestrated in Python and run as a Render-hosted containerized job. Temporary files are deleted after upload to free disk space.
projects.why: It automates the manual workflow of producing YouTube Shorts, shrinking the time from idea to published video to a few minutes.
projects.impact: Demonstrates full-stack automation of media generation, cloud deployment, and API integration in Python.
highlights: Automated cleanup of ~100 MB temp files

projects.name: Rak_sh_ak
projects.description: An image detection app designed for the farmers to detect plant diseases and get information about it, just by clicking the image of the plant.
projects.headline: Image detection app for plant disease identification
projects.what: The app lets farmers capture a crop photo, uploads it, and runs a trained machine-learning model to classify the disease. If the model’s confidence exceeds 51 % the app shows the disease name and symptoms; otherwise it queries a general solution repository and logs the image for expert review. The workflow includes OTP-verified registration, offline operation, and a chat channel to contact specialists.
projects.why: Farmers need rapid, low-cost diagnosis of crop diseases without requiring specialist visits.
projects.impact: Shows integration of mobile UI, on-device ML inference, and a fallback expert-feedback loop.
highlights: On-device ML inference with 51 % confidence rule

projects.name: Helply
projects.description: Helply is a desktop application that helps you in meetings by providing real-time transcription and AI-generated answers.
projects.headline: Desktop AI meeting assistant with live transcription and chat
projects.what: Provides real-time speech transcription and AI-generated answers during calls. Built with JavaScript, HTML and Node.js in a cross-platform desktop runtime, it routes audio to transcription providers and queries LLM backends via OpenAI-compatible APIs. Users configure providers and models through an in-app settings UI.
projects.why: Created to give meeting participants instant notes and on-demand answers without leaving the call.
projects.impact: Shows ability to integrate multiple LLM and transcription services into a unified desktop application.
highlights: Supports cloud and local LLM backends

projects.name: github.sh
projects.description: Script to automate git from working directory.
projects.headline: Menu-driven Git automation script for project directories
projects.what: Provides a configurable menu to run common Git commands from the project’s working directory. Implemented as a Bash wrapper that invokes Python for command handling and state persistence. The script is installed once per repository and reused without further setup.
projects.why: Reduces repetitive typing of Git commands and eliminates manual configuration when switching projects.
projects.impact: Shows ability to combine shell and Python to build a reusable developer tool.
highlights: Persisted settings in a Python config file

projects.name: Bio.Informatica
projects.description: A Common Platform for the study related to Bioinformatics, Computational Biology and Computational Chemistry.
projects.headline: Common platform for bioinformatics, computational biology and chemistry
projects.what: Provides a set of Jupyter notebooks and command-line tools for DNA sequence analysis, bioactivity prediction, solubility estimation, and molecular descriptor calculation. The environment is containerized with Docker and combines Python scripts with Java components to run consistently across systems.
projects.why: Creates a single reproducible workspace for students and researchers to explore multiple bioinformatics tasks without manual setup of dependencies.
projects.impact: Shows ability to integrate Python, Java, and Docker into a cohesive scientific platform.
highlights: Jupyter notebooks for DNA and drug analysis

projects.name: SunaAI
projects.description: SunaAI is a privacy-first AI call intelligence platform that turns phone calls into searchable memory with real-time transcription, summaries, action items, and emotion insights. Built with Flutter and native Android, it uses local encryption and user-owned API keys. Open-core, enterprise-ready, and community driven.
projects.headline: Privacy-first AI call intelligence platform for searchable transcripts
projects.what: Transforms phone calls into searchable memory with real-time transcription, summaries, action items, and emotion insights. Built with Flutter for the UI, native Android/Kotlin for call capture, and a C++ implementation of a time-based encryption algorithm. Uses user-provided Groq API keys so all AI processing stays under the user’s control.
projects.why: Provides call intelligence without sending raw audio or transcripts to cloud services, addressing privacy and data-ownership concerns for professionals and businesses.
projects.impact: Shows ability to combine cross-platform mobile development, on-device encryption, and AI integration in a single product.
highlights: Flutter UI with native Android call capture

projects.name: Monsterrr
projects.description: Creator, Organizer and Maintainer for ni_sh_a.char...
projects.headline: Autonomous AI service for GitHub organization management
projects.what: Provides a FastAPI web API and a Discord bot that automate GitHub organization tasks using Groq LLMs. The Python code runs as separate web and worker processes, selectable via Render or a single-container Docker deployment, and includes health checks, email reporting, and state persistence.
projects.why: Built to reduce manual admin effort by letting an AI select appropriate models for tasks, report activity, and expose controls through Discord and HTTP endpoints.
projects.impact: Shows end-to-end design of a multi-process Python service that integrates LLM routing, web APIs, and messaging bots.

projects.name: NetChat
projects.description: A Java based chatting application that can be used to communicate with other systems on a network.
projects.headline: Java desktop chat application with real-time messaging
projects.what: A Java-based desktop program that lets users exchange messages instantly over a network. It uses Java sockets for real-time communication, stores chat history in MySQL via JDBC, and encrypts messages before transmission. The UI is built with Swing and the project can be compiled in any standard Java IDE.
projects.why: Provides a lightweight, secure way for systems on a LAN to chat without relying on external services.
projects.impact: Shows ability to design and deliver an end-to-end networked Java application with database integration and encryption.

projects.name: DekkhO
projects.description: This app uses newsapi.org to fetch the news from the internet and provides you with different categories to choose news from.
projects.headline: Android news app fetching categories via NewsAPI
projects.what: The app retrieves current articles from newsapi.org and lets users select from multiple news categories. It is written in Java for Android and uses Retrofit for network calls, Picasso for image loading, and RecyclerView for list presentation. The source includes a configurable API key placeholder for deployment.
projects.why: Provides a simple mobile interface to browse up-to-date news without needing a web browser.
projects.impact: Shows competence in consuming REST services and constructing a functional Android UI.

projects.name: curious_shots_
projects.description: An Image Editing App.
projects.headline: Simple Android image editing app
projects.what: Provides basic editing features such as filters and adjustments. Built with a Java UI layer and RenderScript kernels for pixel-level processing.
projects.why: Created as an educational project to practice Android image-manipulation techniques.
projects.impact: Shows competence integrating RenderScript with Java for performance-critical image processing on Android.
highlights: Uses Java UI components for editing controls

projects.name: Kaalka-API
projects.description: Kaalka API is a modern, time-based encryption and decryption RESTful service built using FastAPI, powered by the Kaalka encryption library. This API enables developers and businesses to secure messages using timestamps with simple HTTP requests.
projects.headline: Time-based encryption/decryption REST API with FastAPI
projects.what: Provides /encrypt and /decrypt endpoints that apply time-based encryption using the Kaalka library. Built with async FastAPI, it streams files in memory and validates input with Pydantic. A background task removes temporary files every 60 seconds and the service is containerized via Docker and includes a Streamlit test UI.
projects.why: Offers developers a simple HTTP interface to secure messages and files with timestamp-bound keys, avoiding custom cryptography implementations.
projects.impact: Shows competence in designing an async Python API, integrating background cleanup, and delivering a Docker-ready service.
highlights: In-memory file streaming, no persistent storage
Background task cleans temp files every minute

projects.name: Job-Scraper
projects.description: This is a web scraper solution that extracts job postings from iCIMS career portals. The project demonstrates proficiency in web scraping, Python development, and containerization.
projects.headline: Job posting scraper for iCIMS portals with FastAPI and Docker
projects.what: A service that extracts job postings from iCIMS career portals. It uses Playwright to render JavaScript-heavy pages and falls back to BeautifulSoup for static content. The scraper is exposed via a FastAPI REST endpoint and a command-line interface, and the whole application is containerized with Docker.
projects.why: Organizations need a reliable way to programmatically collect job listings from iCIMS sites that often require browser automation. The project provides an automated, reusable solution.
projects.impact: Shows ability to build an end-to-end Python scraping pipeline with browser automation, API exposure, and container deployment.

projects.name: Assist
projects.description: AI Assistant Overlay is a professional, real-time desktop assistant for your daily productivity. It listens to your spoken questions (via microphone or system audio), sends them to Google Gemini, and displays suggested answers in a discreet, always-on-top overlay window.
projects.headline: Real-time desktop AI assistant overlay for Windows
projects.what: A Python service that captures spoken questions via microphone or system audio, sends the transcription to Google Gemini, and renders the response in a borderless, always-on-top overlay window. It uses Windows APIs to hide the overlay from screen capture and provides a global hotkey to show or hide the UI. The implementation relies on google-genai, speech_recognition, pyaudio, keyboard and requests libraries.
projects.why: It provides hands-free, instant answers without disrupting the user's workflow, addressing the need for quick information retrieval while working on other applications.
projects.impact: Demonstrates end-to-end integration of speech recognition, LLM APIs, and custom Windows UI in Python.

projects.name: Medical-Portal
projects.description: A full-stack Golang web application with a PostgreSQL database for managing patient records in a medical setting. The application features two main portals: a Receptionist Portal and a Doctor Portal.
projects.headline: Full-stack Go medical portal with receptionist and doctor interfaces
projects.what: Provides a web UI for receptionists to register patients and perform CRUD on records, and for doctors to view and update patient details. Built with Go’s net/http server, PostgreSQL for persistence, and a Tailwind-styled HTML/JS front-end. Authentication uses JWT and role-based access control.

projects.name: Touropedia
projects.description: A responsive travel website using HTML, SCSS, CSS and Javascript.
projects.headline: Responsive travel website built with HTML, SCSS, and JavaScript
projects.what: The site presents travel content with a layout that adjusts to phones, tablets, and desktops. It is built with semantic HTML, SCSS for modular styling, and vanilla JavaScript for interactive elements. All assets are compiled and deployed via simple shell scripts.
projects.why: Created to provide a mobile-friendly travel information portal without relying on external frameworks.
projects.impact: Shows end-to-end front-end development and responsive design skills.

projects.name: Emessages
projects.description: Image Stegnography Tool for Encoding and Decoding a picture with encrypted message.
projects.headline: Image steganography tool for encoding and decoding messages in pictures
projects.what: The tool embeds an encrypted text payload into a bitmap using least-significant-bit steganography and extracts it back to plain text. It is written in Java with a thin Shell wrapper to invoke the Java classes from the command line. Encryption of the payload uses standard AES before embedding.
projects.why: It provides a way to hide confidential information inside ordinary images without requiring external services.
projects.impact: Demonstrates end-to-end implementation of cryptographic steganography in Java.

projects.name: Mailbook
projects.description: A JSP-JDBC-MySQL-Servlet based Java project to demonstrate CURD Operations where Users can create, update, edit and delete their name, email and country respectively.
projects.headline: Java JSP/Servlet CRUD demo with MySQL
projects.what: Provides a web interface for creating, reading, updating, and deleting user records stored in a MySQL database. Implemented with JSP for view rendering, Servlets for request handling, and JDBC for database access, packaged as a Maven web application.
projects.why: Built to illustrate end-to-end CRUD operations in a Java web stack.
projects.impact: Shows ability to integrate Java EE components and manage relational data through JDBC.
highlights: Full CRUD UI with JSP pages

projects.name: Safe-Editor
projects.description: A user authenticated text editor that stores the username and password in SHA-256 bit encryption form.
projects.headline: Authenticated text editor with SHA-256 credential storage
projects.what: A desktop text editor that requires users to log in before editing files. Credentials are hashed with SHA-256 and stored, preventing plain-text passwords. The application is written primarily in Java with supporting shell scripts and Python utilities for build and testing.
projects.why: Provides a simple editing tool while ensuring password data is protected using cryptographic hashing.
projects.impact: Shows competence in implementing authentication flows and secure password handling in Java.

projects.name: ni_sh_a.char-IDE

projects.why: Creates a lightweight alternative to heavyweight IDEs for quick script development and testing on a local machine.
projects.impact: Shows competence in building end-to-end desktop tools that combine UI, process control, and output handling.
highlights: Run button launches scripts via shell

projects.name: RESENTMENT---kernel

Managed build and container scripts with Maven and Docker
Authored 123 of 138 commits covering core logic and tests

projects.name: Dev-Automation-Script

projects.what: Provides a command-line menu that runs common Git commands and Docker build/push workflows from a project directory. Implemented as a Bash wrapper (dash.sh) that invokes Python helpers for configuration and Dockerfile generation. Distributed as a Docker image for consistent execution across environments.
projects.why: Reduces manual repetition of version-control and containerization steps, especially for developers switching between projects or using WSL on Windows.

projects.name: Financer

projects.what: Provides stock, real-time, MPG, and generic data visualizer dashboards built with Python and Streamlit. The codebase includes Jupyter notebooks for exploratory analysis and is packaged in a Docker image for consistent execution.
projects.why: Created to give analysts a single, reproducible environment for exploring and visualizing financial data without manual setup.
projects.impact: Shows end-to-end delivery of a data-driven web app with containerized deployment.

projects.name: Blogs

projects.why: Provides a simple platform for users to publish personal content without relying on third-party services.

projects.name: Scanner

projects.what: Builds an Android app that captures camera frames and extracts barcode or QR data in real time. The app is written in Java and integrates Google ML Kit for fast, on-device barcode recognition. Scanned results are shown on a simple UI.
projects.why: Provides a lightweight, offline solution for reading barcodes and QR codes without third-party services.
projects.impact: Demonstrates end-to-end Android development with ML Kit integration and camera handling.

projects.name: Portfolio

Command palette for fuzzy project search
Static export with installable PWA manifest

projects.name: AuroraDB

Built web UI for interactive testing

projects.name: Humsafar

projects.what: The project provides a self-hosted web browser that loads and displays web pages. It is written primarily in Python and packaged with a Dockerfile for isolated execution. The code includes navigation logic and basic HTML rendering capabilities.
projects.why: It was created to explore browser fundamentals and to have a lightweight, personal browsing tool.

projects.name: ai-agents-positive-connections

The analysis extracts, cleans, and processes this data to generate performance insights and rankings.

projects.what: The script reads a CSV containing Binance trade histories stored as JSON-like strings, parses them into structured records, and computes financial indicators such as ROI, PnL, Sharpe Ratio, maximum drawdown, and win rate. The implementation uses Python with pandas for data manipulation and NumPy for numerical calculations.

projects.impact: Demonstrates end-to-end data cleaning, feature engineering, and financial metric computation in Python.

projects.name: Lets-Upgrade-React-Assignment
projects.description: A repository for learning React from Lets Upgrade
projects.headline: React learning assignment
projects.what: A small React application created to practice component composition, state handling, and styling. Built with JavaScript, JSX, HTML and CSS using npm scripts for development and build.
projects.why: The project was made to follow the Lets Upgrade React curriculum and gain hands-on experience with the library.
projects.impact: Shows ability to scaffold a React project and implement basic UI components.
highlights: Configures npm scripts for dev and build

projects.name: Ecommerce
projects.description: A dummy ecommerce website.
projects.headline: Static dummy ecommerce website
projects.what: Provides a set of static pages that simulate product browsing, cart, and checkout flow. Implemented with HTML for structure, CSS for styling, and a shell script for deployment.
projects.why: Created as a learning project to practice web layout and basic site organization.
projects.impact: Shows competence in building end-to-end web pages without a framework.

projects.name: Gitapp
projects.description: A github app to view user and add them as favorite.
projects.headline: GitHub app to view users and add favorites
projects.what: A service that authenticates with GitHub, fetches user profiles, and lets the user mark profiles as favorites. Built primarily in Kotlin with shell scripts for setup and deployment. Communicates with the GitHub API over REST.
projects.why: Provides a quick way to browse GitHub users and keep a personal list of preferred accounts without leaving the app.
projects.impact: Shows competence in integrating third-party APIs and building end-to-end Kotlin services.
highlights: Implements OAuth flow for GitHub app
Uses Kotlin coroutines for async API calls

projects.name: UI_Dashboard
projects.description: A simple UI dashboard using android studio.
projects.headline: Android UI dashboard app
projects.what: A simple Android application that displays a dashboard UI built with Java in Android Studio. The project consists of a single activity with layout resources defining the visual components.
projects.why: Created to provide a basic interface for presenting information on an Android device.
projects.impact: Shows competence in constructing Android UI components with Java.
highlights: Project organized with Android Studio conventions

projects.name: ItzFizz-Task
projects.description: Task for ItzFizz
projects.headline: Static web page for ItzFizz task
projects.what: A client-side page that presents the ItzFizz coding challenge and displays results based on user input. Built with HTML for markup, CSS for styling, and JavaScript for the interactive logic.
projects.why: Created to showcase front-end implementation of a common programming exercise and to practice DOM manipulation.
projects.impact: Demonstrates ability to deliver a complete interactive web page using core web technologies.

projects.name: Inventory-Management-System
projects.description: A comprehensive inventory management system built with Django and MongoDB. This application allows users to manage products, suppliers, stock movements, and sales orders efficiently.
projects.headline: Inventory Management System with Django and MongoDB
projects.what: A web application that tracks products, suppliers, stock movements, and sales orders. Built with Django for the server side and MongoDB as the document store, rendering HTML templates for the UI. Provides CRUD interfaces for inventory entities.
projects.why: Needed a simple tool to manage inventory data without a relational database.
projects.impact: Demonstrates ability to integrate Django with a NoSQL backend and implement full-stack CRUD flows.
highlights: CRUD UI for products and suppliers
Handles stock movement and sales orders

projects.name: HealTether
projects.description: The assignment task for HealTether
projects.headline: React/Redux web app with authentication
projects.what: A web application built with React and Redux that provides login and registration pages. The app defines routes to render the authentication components and uses a Redux store to track user authentication status and data. State transitions are handled through Redux actions and reducers.
projects.why: It supplies a basic user authentication flow and centralized state management for a single-page interface.
projects.impact: Shows competence in constructing React components, routing, and Redux-based state handling for auth features.

projects.name: Joker
projects.description: DevProjects - Joke telling bot mobile app - Joker
projects.headline: Joker - Flutter mobile app for telling jokes
projects.what: A mobile app that displays jokes to the user. Built with Flutter using Dart for UI and logic, and includes native modules written in C++ and Swift compiled via CMake.
projects.why: Created to demonstrate a simple cross-platform joke bot as part of a DevProjects assignment.
projects.impact: Shows ability to assemble a Flutter project with native extensions for iOS and Android.

projects.name: kml-visualizer-pro
projects.description: This project visualizes KML data on an interactive Leaflet map built with React.
projects.headline: Interactive KML visualizer with React and Leaflet
projects.what: A React application that loads a KML file and displays its points, line strings, and polygons on a Leaflet map. The UI includes a sidebar that lists element names, types, coordinates, and lengths. Built with TypeScript for type safety and CSS for styling.
projects.why: Provides a quick way to inspect geographic data without needing GIS software.
projects.impact: Demonstrates ability to integrate third-party mapping libraries with typed React code.

projects.name: media-transcriber
projects.description: A Python-based tool that extracts and transcribes audio from media files using MoviePy and OpenAI's Whisper.
projects.headline: Python tool that extracts audio from media files and transcribes it with Whisper
projects.what: The service extracts audio tracks from MP3, WAV, MP4, MKV, FLAC, and OGG files using MoviePy and ffmpeg, then feeds the audio to OpenAI's Whisper model for speech-to-text conversion. It writes the transcription to a plain-text file and a JSON file for downstream use. The script is a single Python entry point configurable via a model name variable.
projects.why: It automates the otherwise manual process of pulling audio from video containers and generating accurate transcripts, useful for content indexing and accessibility.
projects.impact: Shows ability to combine multimedia processing libraries with AI transcription models in a fully automated Python workflow.
highlights: Extracts audio from MP4/MKV via MoviePy

projects.name: movie-review-system
projects.description: A movie review system made using Java and Spring Boot
projects.headline: Movie review system built with Java Spring Boot
projects.what: Provides a REST API for creating, reading, updating, and deleting movie reviews. Implemented as a Spring Boot application using Java, with Spring MVC handling HTTP requests and Spring Data JPA managing persistence.
projects.why: Enables storage and retrieval of user-generated movie reviews through a simple web service.
projects.impact: Demonstrates ability to develop a complete Spring Boot backend from source to deployment.

projects.name: ecommerce_inventory
projects.description: E-commerce Inventory Management System
projects.headline: E-commerce Inventory Management System
projects.what: A service that tracks product stock levels for an online store and exposes basic CRUD operations for inventory items. The repository contains the source code and configuration needed to run the system as a web application.
projects.why: Provides a centralized way to keep inventory data consistent and up-to-date for e-commerce operations.
projects.impact: Demonstrates ability to design and implement an end-to-end inventory management backend.
